title: SURF: Steering the Scalarization Weight to Uniformly Traverse the Pareto Front
abstract: arXiv:2605.20619v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scalarization is widely used in multi-objective optimization owing to its simplicity and scalability. In many applications, the goal is to generate solutions that represent diverse user preferences, ideally with uniform coverage of the Pareto front (PF). However, uniformly sampling scalarization weights usually induces non-uniform coverage of the PF. We explain this mismatch through the geometry of the scalarization path. As the weight varies, the corresponding solutions traverse the PF at a generally nonuniform speed. Integrating this speed gives cumulative arc length. After normalization by the total length, it defines a cumulative distribution function (CDF) on weights whose inverse selects points at equal arc-length intervals. Building on this insight, we propose SURF (Sampling Uniformly along the Pareto Front). translated_title: SURF：调控标量化权重以均匀遍历帕累托前沿
translated_abstract: 标量化方法因其简单性和可扩展性在多目标优化中被广泛使用。在许多应用中，目标是生成能够代表多样化用户偏好的解，理想情况下这些解应均匀地覆盖帕累托前沿（PF）。然而，对标量化权重进行均匀采样通常会导致帕累托前沿的非均匀覆盖。我们通过标量化路径的几何结构解释了这种不匹配现象：随着权重的变化，相应的解通常以不均匀的速度遍历帕累托前沿。对该速度进行积分可得累积弧长，经总弧长归一化后，它定义了一个关于权重的累积分布函数（CDF），其反函数可用于选取等弧长间隔的点。基于这一见解，我们提出了SURF（沿帕累托前沿均匀采样）方法。对于包括双目标老虎机在内的结构化问题，我们推导了该CDF映射的解析表达式以及由此产生的……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SURF方法，通过将权重变化时解在帕累托前沿上的移动速度积分得到的累积弧长归一化为CDF，并利用其反函数调控标量化权重的采样，从而实现对帕累托前沿的均匀覆盖。
